The handwriting was careful, childlike: 'If you find this, please tell the light it helped my father come home.' No date, no name. Tomas read it three times. That night he lit the lamp a little earlier, and stood longer at the rail, watching the beam sweep the dark.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一台没关机的旧电脑，屏幕暗着，风扇还在低声转。路灯把空荡荡的街道照成橘黄色，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水，声音拖得很长。便利店的灯永远亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处工地的塔吊静止不动，像一只睡着的鹤。高楼里只剩零星几扇窗还亮，不知是谁在加班，还是谁失眠。清洁工推着车慢慢走，扫帚沙沙作响。天边还没有亮，但空气已经开始变凉，城市在等待醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by asking a smaller version of itself to solve a smaller piece.\n- It's like Russian nesting dolls: you open one, find a smaller one inside, and keep going until you reach the tiniest doll.\n- The tiniest doll is the 'stop' point, and once you reach it, you put all the answers back together on the way out."}
